name: managePatientDataRights
shortDescription: Manages patient requests for data access, correction, or deletion in compliance with privacy regulations.
description:
Overview

Handles patient requests for accessing, correcting, or deleting their personal and medical data in compliance with privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR). This function orchestrates the workflow for data rights management.

Intended use

Called by the patient-facing UI when a patient submits a data rights request. Parameters include the patient ID, request type (access, correction, deletion), and details. It returns the status of the request.

Logic

  1. Validate the input parameters, ensuring a valid patient ID and request type are provided.
  2. Based on the request type:
    • For 'access': Retrieve all relevant Patient, MedicalRecord, and ConsentRecord data for the patient using ctx.data.query.
    • For 'correction': Update specific fields in Patient or MedicalRecord as requested, after appropriate verification.
    • For 'deletion': Mark relevant records as deleted (soft delete) or anonymize data in Patient and MedicalRecord entities.
  3. Update the ConsentRecord entity to reflect any changes in data access or processing consent.
  4. Audit-log the data rights request and its outcome with ctx.audit.log, including the patient ID and request details.
  5. Return a confirmation of the request processing.

Entities

  • Patient
  • MedicalRecord
  • ConsentRecord
